spec.question: We are considering removing the special treatment of a single nonempty mapping during interpolation. In native logging, `_maybe_interpolate` would always use the positional argument tuple whenever arguments are present. In `PositionalArgumentsFormatter`, a tuple containing one nonempty dictionary would likewise remain a tuple rather than being unwrapped for named placeholders. The no-argument behavior and removal of `positional_args` would remain unchanged. Which existing tests would newly fail under exactly this change? Reply with a JSON list of pytest node IDs.
